translated_text: In 1940, Elise made a father A passerby and was no longer a challenge. Yes, you are good! ... A. I told you so, He is always filled with your sweet image, He piously read the words you wrote, Savoring the fragrance of your laughing messes. Ah! How I understand loving you like this! Beautiful as Love, your large mermaid eyes Sparkle with a pure radiance --- you will always be queen wherever the trace of your steps will mark. Happy, happy to tell you this and sign: Why not? Your fervent admirer, For once you have been seen, you are not forgotten! Oh! Let me tell you this in passing. Eval & Bohudh EDOUARD MAUREL PEZENAS TELEPHONE: 45 Madame Ruberk at Neidenthal Grand Hotel EDOUARD MAUREL PEZENAS TELEPHONE: 45
